title: Sports-focused prediction market Novig raises $75 million to challenge Kalshi and Polymarket (Fortune)
notes: Fortune (Leo Schwartz), 2026-02-18. Novig $75M Series B led by Pantera Capital, $500M valuation; Multicoin participated. Cofounder/CEO Jacob Fortinsky started Novig 2021 (Harvard senior year) with cofounder Kelechi Ukah; YC the following year. Sports-focused prediction market vs Kalshi/Polymarket.
